names.why: No company source sets a date. Nurix has not pre-announced a fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended 2026-08-31) results date. Its release list runs to 2026-10-07 (CLL combination trial) with no results-date or call notice (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/NRIX/). The 8-K index shows the last item 2.02 on 2026-07-09 and nothing since (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001549595&type=8-K). Nurix did not pre-announce its 2026-07-09 print either, so a missing notice is weak evidence that no print is coming. Prior fiscal Q3 prints fell on 2021-10-14, 2022-10-06, 2023-10-12 and 2025-10-09 (amc, 4:00 PM ET call per https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2025-10-9-nurix-therapeutics-inc-stock), so 10-08 amc is plausible. But the only evidence for this window is the calendar row plus that cadence, and the cadence prior is the thing that put TRT into the book. The IR site (ir.nurixtx.com) and GlobeNewswire both returned 403. Do not spend an Opus hunter on it unless an 8-K 2.02 or a release appears after 16:00 ET today.
